svg.text: Bag End and the Long-expected Party
Frodo inherits; Gandalf rides off to investigate
Merry and Pippin join; Strider is revealed
Frodo is wounded; the Black Riders close in
Aragorn carries the company to Rivendell
THE FELLOWSHIP OF THE RING — nine walkers, one bus
Gandalf falls — the strand leaves the company
Gollum, off to the side, begins to follow
The Fellowship of the Ring — a character alluvial
Eleven strands across nine beats. Convergence is a scene; divergence is a story. Ribbon width approximates screen presence — not a measure of importance.
An alluvial diagram: a Sankey whose horizontal axis is time. Built by hermes-agent — pure hand-authored SVG.
